notes: Solver settings and sandbox rod models. 'design' values are deliberate engineering choices, not claims about reality. 'placeholder' values claim to describe a real device but have no source yet; the device inspector shows them with a badge.

linearDamping.note: Stand-in for blood drag; tune by feel.

angularDamping.note: Stand-in for blood drag on twist; tune by feel.

gravity.note: Omitted in M1: wires and catheters are thin and supported by blood and vessel walls, so their weight is small next to bending and contact forces. Revisit in spec 04.

lumenContactMargin.note: Extra clearance kept between device surface and lumen wall to avoid jitter.

settleKineticEnergy.note: Below this total kinetic energy a static test counts as settled.

lumenGridCell.note: Cell size of the uniform grid over lumen capsules.

settleSteps.note: A static test counts as settled after this many consecutive steps below settleKineticEnergy.

maxStepsPerMessage.note: Most steps the worker runs per main-thread message; beyond this the sim runs in slow motion instead of skipping.

maxStepsPerMessageFast.note: Used only with the ?fast=1 test flag so end-to-end tests are not limited by slow headless rendering.

contactActivationDistance.note: A node within this distance inside its allowed lumen surface keeps its contact active, so resting contact does not flicker on and off. Added in M1 phase B (docs/M1-plan.md D29).

contactSolvePasses.note: Most solves per substep while lumen contacts are added (a node ended beyond the wall) or released (the contact would pull the node onto the wall), so contact only pushes. Added in M1 phase B (docs/M1-plan.md D29).

frictionSlipSpeed.note: Below this sliding speed Coulomb friction is regularized (proportional to speed) so sticking does not chatter. Added in M1 phase B (docs/M1-plan.md D29).

frictionSlipSpin.note: The same regularization for torsional friction against the wall. Added in M1 phase B (docs/M1-plan.md D29).

loadRelaxSteps.note: At load the devices relax into their rest shapes for this many steps before step 0, so a pre-shaped tip that starts straight does not snap in the first frame. Added in M1 phase B.

maxPhysicsPerFrame.note: Startup benchmark: if 300 steps of phantom C cost more than this per 16.7 ms frame, use the standard tier.

benchmarkSteps.note: Steps of phantom C run at startup to choose the tier.

hubForceFullScale.note: Resistance meter full scale. A display scale, not an injury threshold.

hubForceWarning.note: Resistance meter turns amber. A display threshold, not an injury threshold.

hubForceDanger.note: Resistance meter turns red and rumble pulses. A display threshold, not an injury threshold.

wallStressThreshold.note: Tip normal force above this accumulates wall stress, the hidden risk that drives dissection from M2 on. Not a validated injury threshold; tune with faculty.

tipForceNodes.note: Tip normal force sums the contact forces on this many most-distal nodes.

rodModels.variantNote: Diameter, tip shape and length are chosen from the item's sourced options.

toTip.note: Within the sourced 1-8 cm flexible tip range (terumo-glidewire-brochure); 3 cm chosen.

youngsModulusRatio.note: Tip stiffness relative to the body; the flexible tip is 1-8 cm long (terumo-glidewire-brochure), its stiffness is unpublished.
Linear ramp from tip to body.

toTip.note: Factory angled-tip geometry is unpublished; 3 mm borrows the iliac tip-shaping length from eurointervention-guidewires.

tipBoost.note: Tip drawn darker on fluoro so it can be found.

length.note: The item lists no lengths; 145 cm is within the standard 145-180 cm range (radiologykey-tools).

youngsModulusRatio.note: Very floppy tip (lsu-primer); length and stiffness unpublished.

materialAssumption.note: Core material not stated in the sources.

length.note: The item lists no lengths; 180 cm is within the 180-300 cm exchange range (radiologykey-tools).

toTip.note: Harrison measured the stiff segment 60 cm or more from the floppy tip, so the body modulus applies from there.

youngsModulusRatio.note: Linear ramp from tip to the measured body.

materialAssumption.note: Core material not stated in the sources.

rodModels.variantNote: Outer diameter and length chosen from the item's sourced options and range.

innerDiameter.note: Must exceed the largest compatible wire (0.038 in, sourced); confirm from the instructions for use.

youngsModulus.note: Effective modulus of a braided 5F shaft; unpublished.

toTip.note: Curve geometry unpublished; build from the manufacturer's drawing.

bendAngle.note: Simple angled tip (dir-catheters-2023: simple curve); build the true curve from the manufacturer's drawing.

handHoldMargin.note: Wire length that must stay outside the catheter hub to hold it; used by the limit-wire-length rule.
